command: uv run python -m eval.stress_battery --source <corpus data> --scratch <dir> --out <record> --queries <16 titles> --tokenizer legacy --passes 3 --fresh 3 --fresh-qids L0,L11,L23 --path-qids L0,L6,L11,L17,L23 --runs 3

corpus.tokenizer: LEGACY (the file predates the recorded identity)

queries.titles: 16: the earlier study's ten-query subset (L0..L25, its ids) and six drawn independently (S0..S5); texts not recorded

stratum: not run: a sentence admitting the dialogue stratum loads every row of it with its vector (`all_rows(DIALOGUE_READ)`, core/sentence/universe.py) and builds dense n by n matrices over the items; the study's record has 4.3-4.7 GB at 10,000 items, and the whole corpus would need tens of GB. It belongs to a bounded universe, not to this battery

migration.note: the first open of a store from before the change; each on a fresh clone (cold file), during the after runs
